claim: Temporary liquidity imbalance causes a price concession followed by partial recovery.
why_it_might_persist: Compensation for supplying immediacy and bearing inventory risk. Persists because someone must be paid to take the other side, not because others have failed to notice.
observable_prediction: Conditional reversal should increase with measured spread and liquidity stress, monotonically.
falsifier: No monotonic relationship between liquidity stress and subsequent reversal after costs. A single stressed bucket working while its neighbours do not is an optimised parameter, not this mechanism.
